questions.stem: The relationship between the variables $x$ and $y$ is defined by an exponential equation. When $x = 0$, the value of $y$ is $30$, and for every increase in the value of $x$ by $1$, the corresponding value of $y$ increases by $70\%$ of its previous value. Which equation represents this relationship?

(The underlined part of the text is shown here in bold.)
$f(x) = 5{,}470(0.64)^{\frac{x}{12}}$

The function $f$ gives the value, in dollars, of a certain piece of equipment after $x$ months of use. If the value of the equipment decreases each year by $p$% of its value the preceding year, what is the value of $p$ ?

An exponential function $f$ gives the estimated amount of an X-ray beam's initial intensity remaining after passing through a $w$-centimeter-thick window made of beryllium. The function estimates that after passing through a $1.8$-centimeter-thick window, the amount of the X-ray beam's initial intensity remaining is $0.65$. Which equation could define $f$?

$$p=20+\dfrac{16}{n}$$

The given equation relates the numbers $p$ and $n$, where $n$ is not equal to $0$ and $p>20$. Which equation correctly expresses $n$ in terms of $p$?

$$\frac{1}{4xy}+xyz=\frac{1}{3yz}$$

In the given equation, $x$, $y$, and $z$ are positive numbers. Which expression is equivalent to $y$?

$\sqrt[3]{p^{2}} = t^{\frac{9}{7}}$

In the given equation, $p > 1$ and $t > 1$. If $t = p^{3n - 1}$, where $n$ is a constant, what is the value of $n$?

When the quadratic function $f$ is graphed in the $xy$-plane, where $y=f(x)$, its vertex is $(-3,6)$. One of the $x$-intercepts of this graph is $\left(-\dfrac{17}{4},0\right)$. What is the other $x$-intercept of the graph?
In the $xy$-plane, the graph of the equation $y = -x^2 + 9x - 100$ intersects the line $y = c$ at exactly one point. What is the value of $c$?

In the $xy$-plane, a parabola has vertex $(9, -14)$ and intersects the $x$-axis at two points. If the equation of the parabola is written in the form $y = ax^2 + bx + c$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are constants, which of the following could be the value of $a + b + c$ ?

A psychologist designed and conducted a study to determine whether playing a certain educational game increases middle school students’ accuracy in adding fractions. For the study, the psychologist chose a random sample of 35 students from all of the students at one of the middle schools in a large city. The psychologist found that students who played the game showed significant improvement in accuracy when adding fractions. What is the largest group to which the results of the study can be generalized?

options.C: All middle school students in the city

questions.stem:
A statistician conducted a study to investigate the relationship between the average number of minutes piano students practiced each week and the percentage of correct notes the students played during a recital. For the study, the statistician selected a sample of $85$ piano students at random from all the piano students in a certain region who were in their second year with their conservatory. The table shows the information for the $75$ piano students in this sample who practiced at least $50$ minutes on average each week.

Percentage of correct notes the students played during a recital
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Average number of minutes practiced each week} & \text{Less than } 50\% & 50\% \text{ to } 80\% & \text{Greater than } 80\% & \text{Total}\\\hline 50 \text{ to } 150 & 7 & 28 & 5 & 40\\\hline 151 \text{ or more} & 3 & 11 & 21 & 35\\\hline \text{Total} & 10 & 39 & 26 & 75\\\hline\end{array}$$

Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?

options.A: All piano students who were in their second year with their conservatory
options.B: All piano students in the region
options.C: All piano students in the region who were in their second year with their conservatory
options.D: The $75$ piano students in the sample who practiced at least $50$ minutes on average each week

questions.stem: Square $A$ has side lengths that are $246$ times the side lengths of square $B$. The area of square $A$ is $k$ times the area of square $B$. What is the value of $k$?

The table gives the areas and perimeters of two similar rectangles, where $n$ is a constant.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{Area (square inches)} & \text{Perimeter (inches)}\\\hline \text{Rectangle A} & 630 & 210\\\hline \text{Rectangle B} & 2{,}520 & n\\\hline\end{array}$$

What is the value of $n$?

The table shows the distribution of rooms in a certain facility by seating capacity.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{Seating capacity} & \text{Proportion}\\\hline \text{Less than } 18 \text{ seats} & 26\%\\\hline 18\text{-}40 \text{ seats} & 21\%\\\hline 41\text{-}65 \text{ seats} & 29\%\\\hline \text{Greater than } 65 \text{ seats} & 24\%\\\hline\end{array}$$
If a room in this facility is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a room that has a seating capacity greater than $65$ seats, given that the room has a seating capacity of at least $18$ seats?

The table below shows the distribution of US states according to whether they have a state-level sales tax and a state-level income tax.

2013 State-Level Taxes
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{State sales tax} & \text{No state sales tax}\\\hline \text{State income tax} & 39 & 4\\\hline \text{No state income tax} & 6 & 1\\\hline\end{array}$$

To the nearest tenth of a percent, what percent of states with a state-level sales tax do not have a state-level income tax?

A small business owner budgets \$2,200 to purchase candles. The owner must purchase a minimum of 200 candles to maintain the discounted pricing. If the owner pays \$4.90 per candle to purchase small candles and \$11.60 per candle to purchase large candles, what is the maximum number of large candles the owner can purchase to stay within the budget and maintain the discounted pricing?
Which expression is equivalent to $\dfrac{y + 12}{x - 8} + \dfrac{y(x - 8)}{x^2y - 8xy}$ ?

The scatterplot above shows a company's ice cream sales $d$, in dollars, and the high temperature $t$, in degrees Celsius ($^\circ$C), on 12 different days. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. Which of the following could be an equation of the line of best fit?

figures.alt: Scatterplot titled Ice Cream Sales. x-axis: Temperature (degrees Celsius), 10 to 26, labels every 2. y-axis: Sales (dollars), 300 to 1,000, labels every 100. 12 dots rising from about (12, 480) to about (25, 910). A straight line of best fit runs from about (11, 440) to about (26, 940).

questions.stem:
As part of a study of lake conditions, the water temperature was recorded at different depths below the surface of a certain lake. The data shown in the scatterplot give the recorded temperature, in degrees Celsius, for $7$ depths, in meters, below the surface of the lake.

Which of the following is closest to the slope of a line of best fit for the data shown?

figures.alt: Scatterplot with axes. Vertical axis: Temperature (degrees Celsius), 0 to 25 with labels 5, 10, 15, 20, 25. Horizontal axis: Depth (meters), labels 10 to 80 in steps of 10. Seven points, approximately (15, 21.8), (22, 20.7), (35, 15.8), (47, 16.9), (51, 15.7), (54, 13.8), (70, 12.7). The points fall from upper left to lower right.
